The fish displays the characteristic black anterior head and chest, transitioning to a golden-yellow posterior body with a distinct black vertical band separating the two colors. The dorsal and anal fins are elongated with yellow margins and blue/purple bases. The background consists of blurred blue water and indistinct reef structures.
